name: thoughtfulbits-skills
description: ThoughtfulBits review skills for B2B SaaS product and board leaders: board deck audits, board feedback, product plan feedback, and product feature feedback.

interface.longDescription: Four rigorous review workflows for B2B SaaS leaders: deep board-deck audits, concise board feedback, product-plan reviews, and SPARK feature reviews.
defaultPrompt: Audit the attached board deck before I send it. Identify the few fixes that matter most.
Read the attached board deck like a director and give me the concise meeting-room reaction.
Review the attached product plan or feature spec and tell me where it falls short.
